goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Authenticated snapshots now byte-match the pinned commit, runtime facts are source-derived, the duplicated provenance runtime contract is gone, and focused verification passes. However, exact drift parity remains asymmetric: condition, issue-section, and outcome checks iterate only source branches, so removed branches can leave stale manifest entries undetected; built-in transition shape is checked only through fade; and public value types are not represented or compared. Negative tests cover one optional-property list, one runtime bound, and the commit only. Documentation must not depend on this contract until branch removal, type drift, requiredness, literal, source-tamper, and banned-capability mutations are proved.

worker_package.objective: Complete exact bidirectional public-contract parity and adversarial mutation proof for the authenticated v1.56.3 Flow inventory without changing the authenticated snapshots or duplicating runtime facts.

stop_if: Any public Flow property value type, literal domain, requiredness, or union branch cannot be represented canonically and compared bidirectionally.
Any condition, issue-section, outcome, or transition-kind branch can be removed or reshaped without parity failing.
Negative mutation proof cannot demonstrate failures for branch removal, requiredness/type/literal drift, authenticated-source tampering, and banned capabilities.
Runtime facts are duplicated instead of extracted from authenticated source snapshots.
Authenticated fixtures need alteration, SDK behavior changes are required, or a file outside the allowlist is needed.
Verification fails twice after bounded corrections.

evidence: Fresh remote comparison proved both declaration snapshots and both runtime-source snapshots byte-identical to mean-weasel/bugdrop commit 47a392d1e7b1a8d8adeff1692f6bbbd84696280d.
Fresh SHA-256 and Git-blob calculations match every recorded declaration/runtime source digest.
Fresh focused verification passed 26 tests across flow-capabilities and integration-resource suites.
PROVENANCE.json contains authenticated source metadata and no duplicated runtimeContract.

test/helpers/flow-capability-parity.ts derives duration bounds, frame bounds/defaults, built-in/custom duration defaults, easing default, direction behavior, immediate replacement, and reduced-motion facts from authenticated runtime snapshots.
Condition parity at lines 434-454 iterates source branches without comparing their complete branch-key set to capabilities.conditions.branches; removal of answer or context is therefore not rejected.
Issue-section parity at lines 508-518 and outcome parity at lines 545-548 likewise lack bidirectional exact branch-set comparison.
Built-in transition requiredness is compared only with transitionBranches.get('fade') at line 484; a per-kind slide or scale-fade shape divergence is not examined.

Property contracts compare names and optionality, but value types such as FlowForm.fields, AttachmentsField.maxFiles, evidence mappings, choice-option values, and outcome result references are absent from the canonical inventory and executable comparison.

test/flow-capabilities.test.ts has negative mutations only for shortText optional properties, duration maximum, and targetCommit; it does not prove branch removal, requiredness, literal/type drift, source tampering, or banned-capability rejection.
